checkpoints.name: advantage_expectation_bound
checkpoints.description: Theorem 4.17 of Lombardi-Ma-Wright (STOC 2024, arXiv 2310.08870v1): there is an absolute constant C > 0 such that every one-query adversary (M, V, Pi) with 1 <= M and 1 <= K has expected distinguishing advantage at most C sqrt(ln M / K) over a uniform function family; the zero-weight-row premise is packaged as a hypothesis, and the Section-3 game layer and the Theorem 4.18 tail upgrade are out of scope (see tests/reference/concept-ledger.md).
